items.description: Hohenzollernhaus in Lüderitz is a historic building known for its distinctive German colonial architecture.
The Nakambale Museum in Oniipa preserves the history of Finnish missionaries and the local Ovambo culture.
Goerke House in Lüderitz is a magnificent colonial-era building, reflecting the town's diamond boom era.
Christuskirche in Windhoek is an iconic Lutheran church, symbolizing peace and the end of colonial wars.
Tintenpalast in Windhoek is Namibia's Parliament building and a prominent landmark in the capital.
Woermannhaus in Swakopmund is a historic landmark with a tower offering panoramic views of the city and ocean.
Goerke House in Lüderitz is a splendid example of Art Nouveau architecture from the diamond mining era.
Turnhalle in Windhoek is a historic building, site of a controversial constitutional conference during apartheid.
Heinitzburg is one of three castles in Windhoek, now a luxury hotel, offering stunning views of the city.
Franke Tower in Omaruru is a historical monument commemorating Major Franke's relief expedition.
Tsumeb Museum, housed in the old mine commissioner's office, showcases the town's mining history.
Kapps Hotel in Lüderitz is a historic hotel, offering a glimpse into the town's rich past.
The Hardap region is known for its irrigation agriculture, supported by the Hardap Dam.
Tsumeb is an important agricultural center, known for maize cultivation and livestock farming.
The Gobabis region is a hub for livestock farming, particularly known for its cattle ranches.
